summary: Plutonian Acquisition Corp. II, a Cayman-incorporated NYSE-listed SPAC (PLUN/PLUNU/PLUNR), disclosed a September 3, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger with Australian proprietary company NT1 Pty Ltd. NT1 shareholders transfer all NT1 shares to a Purchaser vehicle for 50,000,000 Purchaser Shares, implying $500 million consideration at a deemed $10.00 per share, subject to potential adjustment pending independent valuation and Regulation S-K Subpart 1300 technical reports, adjustable only by mutual written agreement. A subsequent SPAC Merger folds Plutonian II into Purchaser; each ordinary share converts into one Purchaser Share, units into units, rights into rights. Watch valuation adjustments, NT1 shareholder approval and regulatory timing.
